title: Integrability of multilinear random evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ be a positive natural number, and let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space. Suppose $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ are independent real-valued random variables on this space, each belonging to $L^p(\mu)$. Then for every real coefficient family $F$ indexed by subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the random variable $\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}} F(S)\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ belongs to $L^p(\mu)$.
hypotheses_covered: the random variables are mutually independent
$F$ is a real coefficient family indexed by coordinate subsets
